module_title: Advanced Tech - Deployment, Deep Learning, and Edge Computing
introduction: Tailored for SSC CGL Tier-2 (Mains) and technical IT Officer exams, this advanced module explores the structural deployment of cloud servers, the neural networks powering Deep Learning, and the latency-reducing mechanics of Edge Computing.

core_concepts.title: Cloud Deployment Models
core_concepts.description:
- **Public Cloud**: Owned by a third party and available to the general public over the internet (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud).
- **Private Cloud**: Dedicated exclusively to one single organization or business (highly secure).
- **Hybrid Cloud**: A combination of both. A company keeps sensitive data on a Private cloud, but uses the Public cloud for general, heavy-traffic operations.

core_concepts.title: Deep Learning & Neural Networks
core_concepts.description: The most advanced subset of Machine Learning. It relies on complex 'Artificial Neural Networks' that are designed to mimic the biological structure of the human brain. It is used for highly complex tasks like Self-Driving Cars (Autonomous vehicles) and advanced Facial Recognition.

core_concepts.title: Generative AI
core_concepts.description:
A cutting-edge branch of AI focused on creating entirely *new* content (text, images, code, audio) rather than simply analyzing existing data. 
Examples: ChatGPT (Text generation) and Midjourney (Image generation).

core_concepts.title: Edge Computing
core_concepts.description: If millions of IoT devices send all their data to a distant cloud server, it causes delays (latency) and wastes bandwidth. 'Edge Computing' solves this by processing the data locally—right 'at the edge' of the network (inside the device itself or a nearby local server)—resulting in ultra-fast, real-time responses.

important_entities.name: The Big 3 Cloud Providers
important_entities.significance:
The global cloud computing market is heavily dominated by three corporate giants:
1. AWS (Amazon Web Services)
2. Microsoft Azure
3. GCP (Google Cloud Platform)

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.alert_title: Edge Computing vs. Cloud Computing Trap
trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: In Tier-2 Mains, expect a comparison question. Remember the geographical difference: Cloud Computing processes data on a Centralized, distant server. Edge Computing processes data Locally, right next to where the data is being generated.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Visualize nested dolls: Artificial Intelligence is the biggest outer doll. Inside it is Machine Learning. And inside ML is the smallest, most advanced core doll: Deep Learning.

exam_strategy_tips: For Mains papers, explicitly memorize the definition of 'Hybrid Cloud'. Additionally, 'Generative AI' (like ChatGPT) is highly likely to appear in Current Affairs/Tech crossover questions.
